$comment: Guided Tour Wizard content (SPEC §4.7, spec/wizard-config.md) — DATA, not code. Every mechanic must be anchored to a built-in Toolkit system (`backing`): a checkbox is a reliability promise, and one that generates broken code is worse than no checkbox. `registryId` must exist in game-registry.json.
preamble: Build the first playable version of this game. Keep it simple, keep it running, and make each item below actually work before moving to the next.

vibes.label: Sunset Arcade
vibes.description: Warm, golden, high-contrast — bright and friendly.
vibes.fragment: Art direction: warm sunset lighting with a golden-hour skybox, saturated arcade colors, and soft bloom. The landing page should feel bright, energetic and inviting.

vibes.label: Neon Night
vibes.fragment: Art direction: night-time scene lit by saturated neon, a dark skybox, strong bloom and glow on emissive surfaces, and wet-looking reflective ground. The landing page should be dark with neon accents.

vibes.label: Low-Poly Daylight
vibes.fragment: Art direction: clean low-poly look, flat unlit-style colors, a bright daylight skybox and simple directional lighting with no heavy post-processing. The landing page should be clean, flat and cheerful.

vibes.label: Moody Fog
vibes.fragment: Art direction: heavy atmospheric fog, desaturated palette, overcast lighting and subtle vignette. The landing page should be muted, moody and cinematic.

crossGenre.label: Play on phones (touch controls)
crossGenre.fragment: Add on-screen touch controls so the game is playable on a phone, using the Toolkit's MobileInputController.

crossGenre.label: Score & timer on screen
crossGenre.fragment: Add an on-screen HUD showing the score and a timer.

crossGenre.label: Music & sound effects
crossGenre.fragment: Add background music and sound effects using TOOLKIT.AudioSource.

crossGenre.label: Pause menu & game-over screen
crossGenre.fragment: Add a pause menu and a game-over screen, following the Toolkit's UserInterface patterns.

crossGenre.label: Visual polish (glow, particles)
crossGenre.fragment: Add visual polish: a DefaultRenderingPipeline with glow, and ShurikenParticles effects at the moments that matter.

crossGenre.label: Online leaderboard
crossGenre.fragment: Add an online leaderboard backed by the connected Game Backend.

mechanics.label: Lap counter & race timer
mechanics.fragment: Add a lap counter and a race timer using the Toolkit RacingSystem.

mechanics.label: Boost pads
mechanics.fragment: Add boost pads on the track that accelerate the car when driven over, using the RacingSystem.

mechanics.label: Drift handling
mechanics.fragment: Tune the car for arcade drift handling using the RacingSystem's drift support.

mechanics.label: AI opponents
mechanics.fragment: Add AI opponent cars that race the track, using the RacingSystem with NavigationAgent pathing.

mechanics.label: Minimap
mechanics.fragment: Add a minimap showing the track and the cars on it.

mechanics.label: Countdown & results screen
mechanics.fragment: Add a race countdown at the start and a results screen at the finish.

mechanics.label: Double jump
mechanics.fragment: Give the player a double jump, via the player controller's jump properties.

mechanics.label: Sprint
mechanics.fragment: Add a sprint, using the controller's run/walk speeds and a sprint input binding.

mechanics.label: Climb & vault over ledges
mechanics.fragment: Enable the built-in climb system so the player can climb and vault over ledges.

mechanics.label: Collectible pickups with counter
mechanics.fragment: Scatter collectible pickups through the level and show a counter of how many have been collected.

mechanics.label: Patrolling enemies
mechanics.fragment: Add patrolling enemies that chase the player when spotted, using NavigationAgent pathfinding.

mechanics.label: Health & damage
mechanics.fragment: Add player health, damage on contact with enemies, and a health display.

mechanics.label: Checkpoints & respawn
mechanics.fragment: Add checkpoints that the player respawns at after falling or dying.

mechanics.label: Sprint & jump
mechanics.fragment: Add sprinting and jumping to the first-person controller.

mechanics.label: Look-at interaction prompts
mechanics.fragment: Add a look-at raycast that shows an interaction prompt when the player is looking at something usable.

mechanics.label: Collectibles
mechanics.fragment: Add collectible objects the player can pick up, with a counter.

mechanics.label: Doors & switches
mechanics.fragment: Add doors that open and switches that trigger them, using hinge joints and trigger volumes.

mechanics.label: Footstep & ambient audio
mechanics.fragment: Add footstep sounds and an ambient audio bed using TOOLKIT.AudioSource.

genres.card: Stack it, smash it, swing it

mechanics.label: Destructible stacks
mechanics.fragment: Add stacks of physics blocks that topple and scatter when hit.

mechanics.label: Ragdoll characters
mechanics.fragment: Add ragdoll characters built from the Toolkit's joint suite.

mechanics.label: Swinging & hanging objects
mechanics.fragment: Add swinging and hanging objects using hinge and distance joints.

mechanics.label: Levers & sliding platforms
mechanics.fragment: Add levers and sliding platforms using slider/prismatic joints.

mechanics.label: Click-and-throw objects
mechanics.fragment: Let the player click to grab an object and throw it, using a raycast and a physics impulse.
